caso.texto:
A thesis claims every sales delay causes lost deals. A fictional set has 20 opportunities: ten fast responses with four advancing, ten slow responses with three advancing. Fit and industry differ. The offer organises tasks but cannot fix poor fit.

A US services team uses the dataset to propose a workflow pilot, but IT access and lead-source differences remain unresolved. The buyer asks whether the result proves causal improvement; it does not.

projeto.instrucoes: Build a bounded thesis, calculate rates, give an alternative explanation and define a test capable of refuting the recommendation.
projeto.gabarito: Observed progress is 40% versus 30%, a 10-percentage-point gap in a small non-comparable sample. It does not prove causality. Fit and source may explain it. Propose comparable criteria and allow a no-benefit outcome.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
